description: Rodin Platform release candidate (eventb-rossi Rodin Bundle) - Event-B IDE (pre-release)
notes: Tracks the newest Rodin Bundle release or -rcN candidate, so between candidates it is
the same build as 'rodin'. Installs to its own Scoop dir alongside the stable 'rodin'
package but shares the 'Rodin' Start Menu shortcut, so the last-installed wins.
Rodin Bundle: Rodin 3.10 with SMT solvers, ProB, the Proof Obligation Cleaner and the
Rodin needs Java 21+ (pulled in via the java bucket); it finds the JDK on PATH.
The download filename embeds a build qualifier (commit date + hash) the tag lacks;
checkver reads it from the newest GitHub release's asset URLs, so url/hash auto-bump.
